title: Disney Mickey Mouse Seiko Watch, Blue Band - Used
descriptionText: The Disney Mickey Mouse Watch by Seiko SII is a charming timepiece featuring the beloved character Mickey Mouse from the Disney franchise. The watch has a blue band, adding a playful pop of color to the design. Perfect for children or collectors of Disneyana, this watch is a delightful way to show off your love for the iconic Mickey Mouse character.
